item.title: Chinese cryptocurrency firms hand Samsung a key win over its Taiwanese rival

item.title: Scammers target Samsung Community and Samsung Members
item.description: On Samsung Community, which is also available in the Samsung Members app, scammers are sending people phishing messages.

item.description: A new report claims that Android 17 (One UI 9.0) will bring support for native gamepad controller remapping, which will improve gaming.

item.description: The first Samsung Ultra phone was also the last in the Galaxy S series to feature a custom CPU core made in-house by Samsung.

item.title: Royal Caribbean's largest cruise ship now has thousands of Samsung TVs
item.description: Samsung has announced that it has supplied over 6,000 TVs and digital signage for Royal Caribbean's largest ship, the Star of the Seas.

item.title: Someone died as their outdated Samsung phone couldn't call emergency services
item.description: Samsung Australia has highlighted devices that can no longer call emergency services. A user unfortunately found that out the hard way.
